qa_status_definitions.PASS: Evaluated against APPROVED_GOLD expectation and matched.
qa_status_definitions.FAIL: Evaluated against APPROVED_GOLD expectation and did not match.
qa_status_definitions.PENDING: Evaluation not yet completed for an otherwise gold-evaluable target.
qa_status_definitions.NOT_EVALUATED: No current selected run exists for this ticker.
qa_status_definitions.NOT_GOLD_EVALUABLE: No currently-referenced expectation for this ticker/pair qualifies as APPROVED_GOLD; a mismatch here must never be reported as a production FAIL.
qa_status_definitions.INCONSISTENT_SOURCE: Two or more current QA artifacts reference different run_ids or different results for the same ticker.
qa_status_definitions.STALE_SOURCE: A historical artifact references an outdated run_id/result that has since been superseded by currently-regenerated artifacts.
